title: maximum-weight-matching: Edmonds, Gabow and Scaling implementations with experimental data
description: C++17 implementations of three exact maximum weighted matching algorithms for general graphs: Edmonds' algorithm organized as in Galil, Micali and Gabow (1986); Gabow's supporting forest and tree-blossom merging (2018); and the Hybrid scaling algorithm of Duan, Pettie and Su (2018). The repository also holds the per-trial records of the experiments reported in An Experimental Evaluation of Maximum Weighted Matching Algorithms: Edmonds, Gabow, and Scaling on General Graphs by Abdulaziz Alfaraj and Ahmed Al-Herz.
